// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export interface CheckedSurfaceDescription {
    readonly description: SurfaceDescription;
    readonly dropped: readonly SurfaceDrop[];
}

export type PresentationCatalog = (capabilityId: string, version: number) => PresentationCatalogAnswer;

export type PresentationCatalogAnswer = "present" | "absent" | "unknown";

export interface SurfaceDrop {
    readonly subject: ActionSubject;
    readonly action?: string;
}

export declare function assertMaterialRef(value: unknown): asserts value is MaterialRef;

export declare function assertSurfaceDescription(value: unknown, candidates: SurfaceDescription): CheckedSurfaceDescription;

export declare function presentationCatalog(actions: unknown, complete?: boolean): PresentationCatalog;

export declare function presentationFormFields(object: PresentationObject, form: FormKind): {
    readonly form: FormKind;
    readonly fields: readonly string[];
} | null;

export declare function presentationOverviewProblems(declaration: PresentationOverviewDeclaration, overview: PresentationOverview): string[];

export declare function presentationValuesProblems(input: PresentationValuesInput, values: PresentationValues): string[];

export declare function validatePresentationDeclaration(manifest: {
    readonly presentation?: unknown;
    readonly actions?: unknown;
}, catalog?: PresentationCatalog): string[];
